description: This file defines an Android Activity named 'FragmentListArray' which uses an inner class 'ArrayListFragment' extending ListFragment to display a list of titles from the 'Shakespeare' class. It demonstrates the use of fragments to show a list and handle item clicks within the fragment.

classes.name: FragmentListArray
classes.description: An Android Activity that hosts a fragment displaying a list of Shakespeare titles.

classes.name: ArrayListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment subclass that displays a list based on Shakespeare.TITLES and logs item clicks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, adding the ArrayListFragment if not already present.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets the list adapter with Shakespeare.TITLES when the fragment's activity has been created.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on list items, logs the clicked item's ID.
